svg.font-family: system-ui, 'Segoe UI', Inter, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: I — Neon night · Thrills & Chills round-3 art concept
svg.text: Night is the base look. A dark navy park; rides, paths and
edges are glowing tubes in cyan, magenta and yellow with
almost no fill. Light pools on the ground, neon in the water.

g.text: Neon = 3 strokes: halo, glow, white core.
No blur needed; additive blend on canvas.
Fill only where light falls: pools, windows.
Guests: silhouette + rim light + 1 glow item.
Canal = the same neon, mirrored and dimmed.
